page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top with the page number at the right. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: cuperem, quàm meipsum vindicatum,
minimè hanc voluptatem dedissem alio-
rum malitiæ, ut omninò, quid dixerint
vel quid objecerint, me sollicitum vide-
rent, aut memorem.
Reliquissem eorum Authores, suâ o-
lim Improbitate & Cauteriatis Consci-
entiis puniendos, quæ nigra illa & falsa
quæ in me jecerunt Scandala satis ipsæ re-
fellent & ulciscentur, atque id Orbi tan-
dem perspicuum facient, juxta parùm
verè excogitata, & indignissimè spar-
sa, quàm nulla curâ humanitatis (quid
enim dicam Officii?) ab iis minime coër-
cita, quorum fides (credo) & existima-
tio, brevi futurum, ut apud ipsum hunc
populum, eodem halitu nigrescat, ex ea-
dem maledicentiæ fornace prodeunte,
quam ita omnibus modis accenderunt, ut
Famam meam & Honorem injecta pe-nitus absumerent.
Magna mihi causa erat (fateor) suspi-
candi innocentiam meam, & accuratius in
illam inquirendi, cum tot singularem
pietatem professos, ita promptos in di-
versum à Me ire perspicerem: Id enim
vulgi animos tam finistra de Me, & cau-
sa Mea opinione imbuerat, ut vix fieri
posse existimarent, ut quis Parti Mee
adhæreret, & non à Deo simul discede-
ret: immo & idem prorsus illis sonabat

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Italic words are marked in <i>. The word "Mee" after "Parti" may be an italic reading, which I could not confirm letter by letter. The first line of the page has partial damage at the start of "vel quid" and in the first line near "dedissem", where the printed spacing looks irregular. The printed text reads "dedi ssem" in the scan, which I have rendered as "dedissem".
